bubble.canvasLabel: Xumbooyinka goobta — cabbirku wuxuu muujinayaa qorshaha (xayeysiis/gaar ah), midabku wuxuu muujinayaa isbeddelka aragtida. Tab si aad u dhaqaaqdo, Enter si aad u furto

ad.title: Diiwaangeli ganacsigayga!
ad.lead: Ganacsigaaga ayaa halkan lagu sugayaa. Diiwaangeli goobtaada Pi oo waxay shaashadda uga soo muuqan doontaa sidii xumbo dhalaalaysa.
ad.full: Dhammaan meelaha qorshaha waa la qaatay hadda. Fadlan dib u hubi mar dambe.
ad.step1: 1. Diiwaangeli ganacsigayga - dooro qorshe, diiwaangeli → ku bixi Pi
ad.step2: 2. Isticmaalka wuxuu si toos ah u bilaabmayaa marka wakhtiga la isku raacay ee lacag bixinta ka dib uu dhaafo.
ad.step3: 3. Inta lagu jiro muddada isticmaalka, goobtaada waxay u muuqanaysaa sidii xumbo guriga ah oo cabbirka qorshaha la doortay.

auth.openInPiBrowser: Fur boggan Pi Browser si aad ugu gasho akoonkaaga Pi.
auth.linkRequired: Waxaad ku gashay Google, laakiin weli lama xiriirin akoon Pi ah. Soo saar koodka xiriirinta Pi Browser oo halkan geli.

piOAuth.failed: Galitaanka Pi wuu fashilmay. Fadlan isku day mar kale.
piOAuth.stateMismatch: Lama xaqiijin karin codsigan galitaanka (dhacay ama tab kale). Fadlan isku day mar kale.

link.title: Xiriiri akoon
link.intro: Ku xiriiri akoonka aad ku gashay Pi Browser galitaanka Google ee browser caadi ah. Ka dib xiriirinta waxaad isticmaali kartaa akoon isku mid ah browser PC ah.
link.piIssueTitle: Si aad uga gasho browser caadi ah sidoo kale
link.codeHint: Soo saar koodka hoose, ka dibna ku gal Google browser PC ah oo geli bogga xiriirinta akoonka (10 daqiiqo gudahood).
link.enterHint: Pi Browser ka fur sitemap.pi → Xiriiri akoon → Soo saar koodka xiriirinta, ka dibna geli koodka 6-da lambar ah.
link.done: Waa la xiriiriyay. Hadda waxaad isticmaali kartaa galitaanka Google sidoo kale.
link.linked: {name} wuxuu ku xiran yahay galitaanka Google.

me.title: Goobahayga
me.empty: Ma aadan qorin wax goobo ah.
me.suspendedNote: Liiska waa la hakiyay sida waafaqsan siyaasadeena
me.withdrawConfirm: Ka noqo liiska {domain}? Waxaa laga saari doonaa tusaha.
me.verifyGuide: Hubinta lahaanshaha domainka (ikhtiyaari): kaliya ku daabac qiimaha hoose {url} goobtaada. Waxaa loo isticmaalaa calaamadda hawlwadeenka la xaqiijiyay.
me.payHint: Isticmaalka wuxuu si toos ah u bilaabmayaa marka wakhtiga la isku raacay ee lacag bixinta ka dib uu dhaafo. Codsiyada aan bilaabin lacag bixinta wakhtiga la isku raacay waa la diidaa. Lacag bixinta waxay ka shaqeysaa Pi Browser oo kaliya.
me.payDeadline: Wakhtiga kama dambaysta ah ee lacag bixinta: codsiga waa la diidaa si toos ah haddii lacag bixinta aan la bilaabin {h} saacadood gudahood.
me.useStartAt: Lacag bixinta waa la dhammaystiray. Isticmaalka wuxuu si toos ah u bilaabmayaa {h} saacadood ka dib.
me.reapplyUntil: Isticmaalka wuu dhammaaday. Dib u diiwaangeli {h} saacadood gudahood si aad u sii haysato domainkan.

form.domainInvalid: Domain aan sax ahayn. Tusaale: mysite.pi
form.piBrandWarn: Domainyada ku bilowda 'pi' waa la diidi karaa ama la hakiyay sida waafaqsan siyaasadda sumadda Pi.
form.name: Magaca goobta
form.imageHint: PNG, JPEG, WebP ama GIF, ilaa 2MB. Si toos ah ayaa loo hagaajiyaa 300×300 px laba jibbaaran (gooyn dhexe) waxaana loo soo bandhigaa sidii astaan wareegsan oo ku jirta xumbooyinka guriga iyo liisaska. Sawirada aan habboonayn waxay keenaan diidmo ama hakad.
form.pvtHint: Waxaa loo isticmaalaa kaliya su'aalaha hawlwadeenka mana la soo bandhigo. Waa loo baahan yahay si loo codsado.
form.pvtRequired: Xiriirka hawlwadeenka ayaa loo baahan yahay si loo codsado.
form.pubHint: Waxaa lagu soo bandhigaa bogga goobta haddii la bixiyo.
form.mvHint: Cinwaan https ah oo loogu talagalay browserada caadiga ah ee aan furi karin .pi. Lama beddeli karo inta la isticmaalayo.
form.planHint: Qorshaha wuxuu dejinayaa cabbirka xumbada guriga, muddada isticmaalka iyo khidmadda isticmaalka (Pi). Qiimo dhimista waxay la xiriirtaa qiimaha 1-bilood; isticmaalka wuxuu bilaabmayaa ka dib marka la bixiyo khidmadda isticmaalka.
form.planLocked: Qorshaha lama beddeli karo inta la isticmaalayo.
form.spkHint: Wuxuu ka dhigayaa xumbada gurigaaga mid dhalaalaysa. Waxaa la bixiyaa iyadoo la raacayo khidmadda isticmaalka, ama waa la shidaa wax ka beddelka inta la isticmaalayo lacag bixin gooni ah.
form.spkPaid: La bixiyay — wuxuu sii jiraa muddada isticmaalka.
form.efctHint: Mid qorshe kasta — Orbit (dayax-gacmeed wuxuu ku wareegsan yahay xumbada), Pulse (hir neefsasho), Comet (dabada raacda). Waxaa la bixiyaa iyadoo la raacayo khidmadda isticmaalka, ama waa la doortaa wax ka beddelka inta la isticmaalayo lacag bixin gooni ah. Waxaa lagu dari karaa dhalaalka.
form.efctPaid: La bixiyay — wuxuu sii jiraa muddada isticmaalka.

admin.title: Maamulka goobta
admin.memoPlaceholder: Sababta ama qoraalka (ikhtiyaari, waxaa loo tusiyaa milkiilaha)
admin.verifyStep1: Fur cinwaankan Pi Browser oo xaqiiji inuu si sax ah ula mid yahay calaamadda
admin.verifyStep2: Haddii ay ka duwan tahay ama aanay furmin, ku diid sababta "Lahaanshaha domainka lama xaqiijin" — milkiilaha isku midka ah mar kale ma codsan karo domainkan
admin.verifyStep3: Xaqiiji in waxa ku jira goobta ay la mid yihiin liiska iyo xeerarka qaybaha mamnuuca ah

apiErrors.AUTH_PI_SESSION_INVALID: Fadhigaagu wuu dhacay. Fadlan mar kale gal
apiErrors.SERVER_CONFIG: Khalad qaabeynta server-ka. Fadlan la xiriir hawlwadeenka
apiErrors.DB_UNAVAILABLE: Xogta si ku meel gaar ah uma heli karto. Fadlan mar kale isku day gadaal
apiErrors.DUPLICATE_DOMAIN: Domainkan horey ayaa loo diiwaangeliyay ama wuxuu leeyahay codsi furan
apiErrors.ALREADY_REPORTED: Goobtan horey ayaad u soo sheegtay. Fadlan sug natiijada
apiErrors.INVALID_STATE: Lama ogola xaaladda hadda. Dib u cusboonaysii oo mar kale isku day
apiErrors.IMG_BUCKET_MISSING: Kaydinta sawirka diyaar ma aha. Fadlan la xiriir hawlwadeenka
apiErrors.IMG_TOO_LARGE: Sawirada waa inay noqdaan 2MB ama ka yar
apiErrors.IMG_TYPE: Kaliya sawirada PNG, JPEG, WebP ama GIF ayaa loo ogol yahay
apiErrors.IMG_URL_INVALID: Kaliya sawirada lagu soo galiyay adeegan ayaa la isticmaali karaa
apiErrors.RATE_LIMITED: Codsiyo badan. Fadlan mar kale isku day dhawaan
apiErrors.PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE: Codsiga aad buu u weyn yahay
apiErrors.SITE_LIMIT: Waxaad ku hayn kartaa ilaa 5 goobood oo qabyo ah ama codsanaya
apiErrors.AUTH_PI_ACCOUNT_CONFLICT: Magacan isticmaale ee Pi horey ayaa loogu diiwaangeliyay aqoonsi kala duwan. Fadlan la xiriir maamulaha
apiErrors.AUTH_PI_ACCOUNT_INACTIVE: Akoonkan ma shaqeeyo. Fadlan la xiriir maamulaha
apiErrors.DOMAIN_REJECTED_OWNERSHIP: Domainkan waa la diiday sababtoo ah lahaanshaha lama xaqiijin karin oo mar kale lama soo gudbin karo. Fadlan la xiriir maamulaha
apiErrors.AUTH_GOOGLE_REQUIRED: Galitaan Google ayaa loo baahan yahay.
apiErrors.LINK_CODE_INVALID: Koodhka isku xirka ma saxna ama wuu dhacay. Mid cusub ka soo saar Pi Browser.
apiErrors.LINK_ALREADY_LINKED: Akoonkan horey ayaa loo isku xiray.
apiErrors.LINK_CODE_GEN_FAILED: Kuma guuldareystay in la abuuro koodh isku xir. Fadlan mar kale isku day gadaal.
apiErrors.AUTH_DB_UNAVAILABLE: Kuma guuldareystay in la keydiyo akoonkaaga, sidaas darteed galitaanku wuu fashilmay. Fadlan mar kale isku day gadaal.
apiErrors.PAY_ALREADY_PAID: Codsigan horey ayaa loo bixiyay. La xiriir maamulaha si aad u beddesho qorshaha ama aad u laabato.
apiErrors.PAY_AMOUNT_SHORT: Cadadka lacag bixinta kuma habboona khidmadda.
apiErrors.PAY_PI_APPROVE_FAILED: Ansixinta lacag bixinta Pi way fashilantay. Fadlan mar kale isku day gadaal.
apiErrors.PAY_PI_COMPLETE_FAILED: Dhameystirka lacag bixinta Pi way fashilantay. Fadlan mar kale isku day gadaal.
apiErrors.PAY_PI_CANCEL_FAILED: Lacag bixinta horey ayay u socotaa oo lama joojin karo. Mar kale gal si aad u dhameystirto.
apiErrors.PAY_IN_PROGRESS: Lacag bixin Pi ah ayaa socota. Mar kale isku day ka dib marka ay dhamaato
apiErrors.PAY_PENDING_REFUND: Codsigan la bixiyay waa la diiday oo wuxuu sugayaa soo celin. Fadlan la xiriir maamulaha
apiErrors.APPLY_COOLDOWN: Domainkan si isdaba joog ah ayaa loo diiday sababtoo ah waqtiyada lacag bixinta oo la seegay. Fadlan mar kale codso gadaal
apiErrors.PLAN_TERM_MISSING: Qorshuhu ma laha muddo isticmaal oo la qaabeeyay. Hubi shaxda khidmadda.
apiErrors.DOMAIN_REJECTED_POLICY: Domainkan waa la diiday sababtoo ah qayb mamnuuc ah oo mar kale lama codsan karo. La xiriir maamulaha.
apiErrors.LINK_TRY_LIMIT: Koodhadh isku xir oo badan oo khaldan. Mar kale isku day 15 daqiiqo ka dib.

cfg.intro: Saacadaha xaaladda khidmadda isticmaalka (saacado, 0.01–720). Qiimaha la keydiyay waxay gaaraan ogeysiisyada daqiiqado gudahood (cache 30 s–2.5 min); kala guurka tooska ah wuxuu akhriyi doonaa marka cron (P5) la soo diro. Tijaabada qalabka, hoos u dhig 0.05, socodsii socodka oo dhan, ka dibna soo celi.
cfg.SITE_PAY_TIMEOUT_HOUR: Waqtiga kama dambaysta ah ee lacag bixinta
cfg.SITE_PAY_TIMEOUT_HOUR_hint: Codsiga waa la diidaa si toos ah (PAY_TIMEOUT) haddii lacag bixinta aan la bilaabin wakhtigan gudahiisa.
cfg.SITE_USE_BGN_DELAY_HOUR_hint: Ka dib lacag bixinta, isticmaalka wuxuu si toos ah u bilaabmaa marka wakhtigan uu dhaafo. Maamulayaashu waxay bilaabi karaan goor hore.
cfg.SITE_REAPLY_WINDOW_HOUR_hint: Ka dib marka isticmaalka uu dhamaado, kaliya codsadaha hore ayaa dib u diiwaangelin kara domainka isku midka ah wakhtigan gudahiisa. Ka dib qof kasta wuu codsan karaa.
